decision_table.name: Determine_AR_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Arkansas state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in AR (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Arkansas filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: Arkansas Form AR1100CT Instructions Reference: AR Code § 26-51-102 (Imposition of tax)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Arkansas filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration Economic Nexus Rules
No Arkansas nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_AR_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Arkansas state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Arkansas state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - IRC Section 199A deduction addback (if Arkansas decouples)
Subtractions may include: - State income taxes paid - Arkansas municipal bond interest
Reference: Arkansas Form AR1100CT Instructions Reference: AR Code § 26-51-205 (Tax computation)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_AR_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Arkansas state corporate income tax. Applies 5.5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Arkansas state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to Arkansas: × [Apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Additions] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions] 5. Arkansas taxable income: = [Result] 6. Arkansas tax rate: × 5.5% 7. Arkansas income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. Arkansas credits: - [Credits] 9. Arkansas tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: Arkansas Form AR1100CT Instructions Reference: AR Code § 26-51-205 (Tax rate: 5.5%)
No Arkansas nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Arkansas taxable income - no tax liability. Arkansas NOL rules may apply (not implemented).
